verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents its own REST API plus TypeScript, Python, and Java SDKs for the Connect service, and the MCP server is reachable programmatically with header-based project, environment, and user scoping. Nothing in the evidence shows that every UI action, such as account connection and revocation at mcp.pipedream.com or project management, is exposed through the API. missing for 10: explicit UI-to-API parity documentation, API coverage of account connect/revoke and project/config management, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Pipedream provides TypeScript, Python, and Java SDKs along with a REST API to interact with the Connect service.
